rows.label: bf02010100_0010
rows.name:
...And so, I barely
escaped with my life, mo.

rows.label: bf02010100_0020
rows.name: Don't 'and so' me, mo!

rows.label: bf02010100_0025
rows.name: Are you an idiot, mo?

rows.label: bf02010100_0030
rows.name:
Why couldn't you just die properly, mo?
What if they demand a refund later, mo?

rows.label: bf02010100_0040
rows.name: Huh? Die? And what do you mean 'refund?'

rows.label: bf02010100_0050
rows.name: Hmph, that's none of your business, mo.

rows.label: bf02010100_0060
rows.name: So where did Rex and that Blade go, mo?

rows.label: bf02010100_0070
rows.name: The Divine Beast carrying Rex and the others...

rows.label: bf02010100_0080
rows.name:
fled south from the Tornea Sea.
After that we lost track of them, mo.

rows.label: bf02010100_0090
rows.name: You see, the storm was very fierce so...

rows.label: bf02010100_0100
rows.name: You don't know, mo?

rows.label: bf02010100_0110
rows.name: Yes, mo...

rows.label: bf02010100_0120
rows.name: And then you ran away, mo?

rows.label: bf02010100_0130
rows.name: Y-yes, mo...

rows.label: bf02010100_0140
rows.name:
Ngh, mo-mo...
I don't want to hear excuses, mo!

rows.label: bf02010100_0150
rows.name: Hurry up and get back here, mo!

rows.label: bf02010100_0160
rows.name: There's a mountain of work piled up, mo.

rows.label: bf02010100_0170
rows.name:
Mo-mo-mo... Even though we had insurance
on the Uzushio, this is a big loss, mo.

rows.label: bf02010100_0180
rows.name: Still...

rows.label: bf02010100_0190
rows.name:
If they went south from
the Tornea Sea...

rows.label: bf02010100_0200
rows.name:
At this time of year, they may
have headed toward Gula, mo.

rows.label: bf02010100_0210
rows.name: Call Consul Morph, mo!

rows.label: bf02010100_0220
rows.name: Understood. Please wait a moment.

rows.label: bf02010100_0230
rows.name:
Well well, Chairman Bahn. Thank
you for your help the other day.

rows.label: bf02010100_0240
rows.name:
Even worthless Core Crystals become
first-rate goods with the Avaritia brand.

rows.label: bf02010100_0250
rows.name:
And the way you sold them back home in Superbia...
As expected of you, Chairman Bahn. I am impressed.

rows.label: bf02010100_0260
rows.name: I don't need your disgusting flattery, mo.

rows.label: bf02010100_0270
rows.name:
Besides, talking about Core Crystals over comms...
Are you an idiot too, mo?

rows.label: bf02010100_0280
rows.name: What if the Holy See intercepts this, mo?

rows.label: bf02010100_0290
rows.name: Th-this... I-I'm sorry.

rows.label: bf02010100_0300
rows.name:
Well, more importantly,
I've got some good news, mo.

rows.label: bf02010100_0310
rows.name: Oh? What do you mean by good news...?

rows.label: bf02010100_0320
rows.name: That would be, mo...
